presentation.label: MIDI EXPRESSION
presentation.summary: Pitch bend, aftertouch, the mod wheel, breath and velocity from MIDI IN play a MIDI track's synth and the Digitakt's own audio tracks, with each track's routings on a second TRIG page.
presentation.overview: Stock, the Digitakt passes the notes of an external keyboard through to the synth a MIDI track plays, but drops pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel. Those messages now follow the notes: on the AUTO CHANNEL to the active track, and on a track's own TRACK CHANNEL to that track. A MIDI track adds them to its own PB, AT and MW (its knob, parameter locks and LFO), within the MIDI limits, on its CHAN out of MIDI OUT. An audio track bends its TUNE and moves two parameters of its choice. Each track's settings are on the TRIG page's second page: tap TRIG on the TRIG page. Selecting another track gives the previous one its own values back. For live playing: nothing is recorded into the sequencer.
highlights: Play a synth through a MIDI track with pitch bend, aftertouch, the mod wheel and breath, added to the track's own values.
Route the wheel, aftertouch and velocity to any value the MIDI LFO reaches (PB, AT, MW, BC, CC VAL 1-8), or to any SRC, FLTR, AMP or LFO amount of an audio track.
Two values on one CC number are merged into one, so the synth never jumps between them.
Velocity sensitivity per track on what plays, live or recorded; the sequencer keeps the velocity as played.
A stock-looking EXPRESSION page on the TRIG page's second page.
usage: Connect a keyboard to MIDI IN on the AUTO CHANNEL; for a synth, connect it to MIDI OUT and switch a MIDI track's CHAN on.
Select a track, press TRIG, then tap TRIG again: set its bend range, routes and velocity sensitivity with knobs A-H.
Play: bends, pressure, the wheel and velocity reach the track.

access.location: The TRIG page's second page: tap TRIG on the TRIG page
steps: Use a build containing MIDI Expression for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Select a track, press TRIG for its TRIG page, then tap TRIG again: the EXPRESSION page. Knobs A-H set the eight cells; FUNC + turn jumps between useful values. TRIG or NO goes back.

controls.name: BEND
controls.doc: Audio track, knob A: OFF, 1-12 semitones of TUNE. Default 2.

controls.name: THRU
controls.doc: MIDI track, knob A: ON adds the input's pitch bend, aftertouch, mod wheel (CC 1) and breath (CC 2) to the track's own PB, AT, MW and BC. Default ON.

controls.name: V.SNS
controls.doc: Audio knob B, MIDI knob D: 0-100 %, how much velocity counts in what plays, live or from the sequencer; 50 % plays 0-127 as 64-127, 0 % plays every note full. The sequencer records the velocity as played, so V.SNS can be changed afterwards. Default 100 %.

controls.name: MW / VEL / AT
controls.doc: Knobs C, E, G: what the wheel, the velocity and aftertouch move. Audio track: an SRC, FLTR, AMP or LFO amount. MIDI track: the MIDI LFO page's list, PB, AT, MW, BC or CC VAL 1-8 (on its SEL's CC number). VEL is the velocity of the last note the track played, live or from the sequencer. Default none.

controls.name: M.DEP / V.DEP / A.DEP
controls.doc: Audio track, knobs D, F, H: -64.00 to +64.00, how far, as finely as the LFO page's DEP, in the stock LFO's scale. Default 0.

limitations: Not saved: every track's settings start at their defaults at every power-on. With BEND set to OFF and no destinations, an audio track is stock; a MIDI track with PB, AT and MW OFF is stock.
Sends to DIN MIDI OUT only, not USB: the stock USB sender is not safe to call from the MIDI input task.
Not recorded: the sequencer never sees the live values.
A bend can reach the synth a few milliseconds before the note played with it.
Digi Perform opens its own page with the same gesture (TRIG again on the TRIG page): the two are not built together.
Avoid a MIDI loop: a synth echoing MIDI OUT back into MIDI IN on the same channel feeds the mod's output back as input.
Two values a MIDI track sends on one CC number are merged while anything live is aimed at them; the track's own value is the one that changed last.

claims: ui:TRIG page:second page, TRIG pressed again

load.conditions: Measure under a flood of notes, CC, pitch bend, aftertouch and clock at the wire rate.

tests.summary: Host unit tests (1955 checks) and the digiemu emulator: routing, sums within limits, release on track change, velocity sensitivity and source, the LFO-stage routes, and the page's keys and knobs. Which parameter words the engine reads, and when, measured with scripts/probe-reads.py. Hardware: 0.4 on the unit by the author (internal sounds).
